chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who speaks after he has pronounced the iqamah for the salat (prayer). He said: Yes.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.سَأَلْتُ: I asked; indicates a direct legal inquiry posed to the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.نَعَمْ: Yes; an affirmative answer indicating permissibility
key_terms.يَتَكَلَّمُ: He speaks; refers to uttering speech after the iqamah
key_terms.يُقِيمُ: He pronounces the iqamah; the commencement call immediately before salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to speak after the iqamah and before beginning salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on speaking after the iqamah has been pronounced for salat (prayer). Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام replies affirmatively, indicating that speaking at that point is permitted.
